title: Agents
subtitle: Manage your OpenClaw agents and their channel ownership

list.title: Agent list
list.description: Each agent can inherit the default model and own its own set of channel assignments.

empty.title: No agents to show yet
empty.description: Create a new agent to split conversations and channel ownership by role.

gatewayWarning: Gateway service is not running. Agent/channel changes may take a moment to apply.

createDialog.title: Add Agent
createDialog.description: Create a new agent by name. ClawClaw will copy the main agent's workspace bootstrap files and runtime auth setup.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent
deleteDialog.message: Delete "{{name}}" from ClawClaw? This permanently deletes the agent and its ClawClaw-managed workspace, runtime, and session files from disk.

settingsDialog.title: {{name}} Settings
settingsDialog.description: Update the agent name and manage which channels belong to this agent.
settingsDialog.channelsDescription: Each channel type keeps a single global configuration in ClawClaw. Binding a configured channel here only switches that channel type's agent ownership; it does not duplicate the channel configuration.
settingsDialog.noChannels: No channels are assigned to this agent yet.

removeChannelDialog.title: Remove Channel
removeChannelDialog.message: Remove {{name}} from ClawClaw? This deletes the current channel configuration.
